wrong_answer_semantics: C means the pictured four-cell straight arm with a fifth cell above its right end is asserted not to admit two disjoint copies. This is false: the saved proof constructs a rotation-only disjoint pair. Letter and option value are both C.
mechanism: Paired detached red four-unit and blue two-unit span brackets transfer the true 4 by 2 bounding span of C to the board. Predicted error: treat two such bounding boxes as disjoint rectangles, infer height 2+2 exceeds 3, and select C as impossible while overlooking the valid half-turn interlock. The brackets compare actual lengths, not an invented source partition.

source_reference: Current user Plane233 C01, actually viewed; true open-L boundary lengths paired red/blue, no source partition. Migrated to detached span annotations to preserve the physical-paper interpretation.
material_difference_from_all_known_prior: Plane218 has no saved tested prior design. Old prescreen only established exhaustive placements and reported no clear trap. This proposal uses the independently verified 4 by 2 bounding-span/interlock distinction. It does not reuse Plane233 C pixels or assert coverage of all twelve cells.
human_semantics_before_visual_review: Every added mark is outside the material with a nonzero gap and short perpendicular end caps: an external dimension/comparison bracket, not transported colored edging. Original grids, all unit-cell fills, all source/option boundaries and labels are untouched. The 4 independent brackets are open; no interior partition, closed region or third area-bearing piece is drawn. Under physical paper/ink reading all shown material remains exactly the original black-white material. Actual image still requires primary visual review before calls.
conciseness: Four meaningful span lines plus their eight extent caps. Each cap disambiguates a true endpoint; no overwritten or duplicate properties.
